notes.title: Big Bugfix Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to all of you who supported [i]Lord Ambermaze[/i] at launch, shared your comments and reviews, and reported bugs. Thanks to you, we’ve got more work to do — and we’ve prepared our very first big bugfix update.[/p][p][/p][p]Update the game, play, and don’t forget to leave a review if you haven’t yet![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what we fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug where the Mushroom Minion during the Lava Kraken boss fight stopped reacting to sword hits and didn’t spawn lava tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where buying Fried Chicken at Blu’s shop didn’t restore HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the game froze when a mob appeared during the Robo-Beetle boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the bottom border of some rooms was cut off on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where controls froze during the Lord boss fight when stone walls reappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where using the “Piercing Shot” perk on spiked balls caused the game to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where certain modifier statues became inactive too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where Robo-Beetle’s minions didn’t disappear after his death.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where a Robo-Beetle minion could become invulnerable if a stalactite fell on it.
Bug where the Rufa statue granting +2 to shots didn’t work.
Bug that prevented players from receiving the final achievements![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blocker when buying mana from Blu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple texture bugs.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Text and localization fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect intro credits starting in the wrong languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of the Vampirism Potion in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of Zeus’s Ring in French.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of the Wind Gust Potion in German.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken dialogues with Diggeria.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous typos in cutscenes and dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous typos in Rufa’s statue and artifact descriptions.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked the final boss and his wave patterns.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the logic in trials where you must attack only with a sword — using the shield is no longer counted as a failure, since it’s defensive, not offensive.
[/p][/*][/list][p]And one more thing: Rufa has lost her levitation powers and no longer floats in the middle of a chasm in some of the colored puzzle rooms.[/p][p][/p][p]With love,
 The Lord Ambermaze Team[/p][p]
[/p]

This is where Zin will finish their long and perilous journey. Expect tough new puzzles, deadly traps, and — attention! — your last chance to romance characters, rescue them from the island, and unlock the most heartfelt (or unexpected!) ending.[/p][p]
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/HLQCSfP9/lord-boss-1mp4.gif"][/img][/p][p]And as the evil plum on top — the ultimate showdown with Lord Ambermaze, who is actually... Nope, we won’t say it. notes.title: Bugs, Love, and Shell Games: What’s New in Lord Ambermaze
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

You’ve already taken a peek at our mysterious new acid biome — now it’s time to meet the creature that calls it home. And no, it’s not a cuddly slime...

Introducing: [b]the Robo-Bug [/b]— a terrifying fusion of metal, darkness, and the twisted experiments of the Dark Lord.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Ngkcd39B/Lord-3.gif[/img]

Half machine, half... yep, you guessed it — beetle. A hulking monstrosity with lasers tucked under its shell, ready to test your reflexes (and patience). Don’t worry — dying is almost fun!

But that’s not all — we’ve packed in a bunch of new mini-games to makeZeyn’s adventure even more exciting.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KckDFkCt/LA-chests.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Feel lucky? Try your hand at the classic shell game and see if you can score some treasure.
[*] Can you escape a pitch-black room with nothing but your instincts?
[*] Solve color puzzles or push some crates around in a good old-fashioned [b]sokoban[/b] challenge!
[/list]
After all, you can’t only dodge spikes and fall into pits, right?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KzyN42Kx/LA-love.gif[/img]

And yes — [b]romance[/b] is in the air!
We’ve added a touch of love to our chaotic world: characters now have charming gift-receiving animations and adorable little hearts floating above their heads. Because even in the darkest dungeons, everyone deserves a little warmth.

Which update caught your eye the most? Let us know in the comments — and don’t forget to add Lord Ambermaze to your Wishlist!
It’s crucial for our survival... as a project, of course. 😅

With love and lasers,
The Lord Ambermaze Team

We’re excited to share the latest updates on the development of Lord Ambermaze! We’ve made significant progress recently, and we can’t wait to tell you what new adventures await you.

We’ve added two brand-new biomes that will bring a lot of variety to your gameplay experience.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hJftyn43/lord-acid.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/sdTfQKvC/lord-castle.gif[/img]

The second biome is the final location, the Dark Lord's Castle. This eerie and intimidating place will be the climax of your adventure. Here, you’ll face the toughest opponents and most complex puzzles that will require your utmost focus and strategic thinking.

notes.title: Carving My Own Path: A Woman’s Journey to Create ‘Lord Ambermaze’
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I’m Anna, the creative visionary, artist, and lead developer of Lord Ambermaze!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/50193172e1a6f16210a1b5e00326126e0de4a127.jpg[/img]

In our small team, I handle everything except programming—my husband Alex takes care of that. Although I initially studied to be a programmer because I wanted to make games, I ended up discovering my passion for art during my second year of university. My journey in game development began as an artist on a mobile project, and since then, I've worked on various other projects, including three board games, an animated short film, and, of course, many mobile games.

But I’ve always wanted to create something of my own, which is why I decided to pursue my projects in 2019. I find inspiration in the ability to create something cool and interesting and express my creativity. In any project, 10% consists of exciting and inspiring tasks, while 90% is routine and tedious work. However, motivation comes from seeing the results and watching your own project come to life and grow.

Not everything comes easily. The biggest challenge is making it to the finish line. Sooner or later, you get tired of one project, your head is full of new ideas, but you have to focus on the current game. I also struggle with delegating tasks to others and seeing things go wrong that aren’t due to my own mistakes.

My favorite game is Beyond Good & Evil, and I have a tattoo of the main character, Jade, on my arm. Other favorites include Red Dead Redemption 2—I've played it multiple times and fell in love with the world and the characters, especially Dutch. I have plans of my own; I just need a little more money!

I want to encourage all the women out there working on their games or dreaming of doing so—don’t be afraid to express yourselves and create! Even if things don’t go as planned, don’t fear making mistakes. Remember to always stay true to yourself, your desires, and your creativity. We are carving our own path!

With love,  
Anna

notes.title: Love Me, Love Me Not? New Dating Mechanics in Lord Ambermaze!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We didn’t just share stories about the lovely inhabitants of the mysterious island for no reason—now, any one of them can become the main character’s beloved partner and loyal ally in the ultimate battle. All you need to do is win her heart and gain her support!

Yes, you heard that right! We’ve added a dating mechanic to our turn-based adventure!

Here’s how it works:

The island is home to many charming ladies, each with her own story, interests, and personality. Any of them could become your sweetheart. After all, every hero deserves a faithful companion, don’t you think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/05c5268ea882503c775174ff28089f42feac44a2.png[/img]

As you explore the labyrinths, you can find special gifts for each of them. For instance, the sculptress will be thrilled with new pickaxes. Show her that you appreciate and respect her work! The more gifts you give, the stronger her affection will grow.

At the end of the game, you’ll have the chance to receive help from your chosen one (or ones) in the battle against the Lord, and after your victory, you can sail away together from the island back home!

You can choose one girl, all of them, or none at all. Want to remain a proud lone wolf? No one will judge you for that; a choice is a choice! Or perhaps you’re eager to romance all the island’s girls? Go for it! Who are we to judge?

Get ready to dive into a world of love and adventure in Lord Ambermaze!

Add the game to your Wishlist, join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url], and leave "hearts" in the comments if you love the new mechanic—and of course, in honor of Valentine’s Day! 💖🏝️

With love,  
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: The Ice Girl, the Digger, and the Loner Witch—More Sad Captives of the Island
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We continue to introduce you to the heroes of the world of Lord Ambermaze. If you missed the first part, you can find it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1811330/announcements/detail/517453005451166608?snr=2___]here[/url]. Don’t forget to refresh your memory, because there’s an important question waiting for you at the end of this post!

For now, let us introduce you to the next trio of heroes.

[h3][b]Dee[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/44e89108e7ffd2206cf3ba6d5e2d8d7c577d543f.png[/img]
The Charming Digger. In her past life, her only close companions were her crew. But on the island, Di found herself alone—her team has vanished. In her endless search for her friends, she is driven to madness by the longing and loneliness in the dark dungeons of the Lord.

[h3][b]Ninelle[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/33b3bcba92f29e43eac5df861792330de2cc8168.png[/img]
Before arriving on the island, she faced hatred and malice from those around her. Unable to cope, she became bitter and began to treat others the same way. But somewhere deep in her heart, love still resides. Perhaps you could reach out to her?

[h3][b]Icy[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/cf52d15ef929fc58fb7dca066cc71b38218cf5b9.png[/img]
In the outside world, she was cold and indifferent to the feelings of others. She cared for no one but herself. It’s no wonder that on this mystical island, she faces a harsh trial: she constantly feels cold. Even in the lava's heat, she shivers from the chill of her soul. A little compassion and love might help her. Probably.

And now for the question: Which of our game’s heroes do you feel a connection with? Who would you take out on a date for Valentine’s Day?

Best regards,  
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Meet the Inhabitants of the Mysterious Island
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’d like to share a bit about the characters of the Lord Ambermaze, whom our brave hero encounters in various corners of the labyrinth. Just like Zeyn, they all accidentally found themselves on the island and have been its captives for many years. Each of them has their own story, motives, and unique traits.

[h3][b]Varion  [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/00b86c960b73ba62395e7be1d39a28d860635fd8.png[/img]
In her past life, she was a hero and a respected citizen of his city. But fame blinded her; the sun of her vanity began to shine brighter than the sun of her heart. Money and popularity are now her main values and the meaning of her life. Is there still a place in her heart for something more?

[h3][b]Blu[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/dcb03265429e1accb9391abe82ca4472d2caa05a.png[/img]
Charming and talented, but she only uses her talents for personal gain—sometimes at the expense of others. Before arriving on the island, she was determined to get rich at any cost, even resorting to fraudulent actions.

[h3][b]Rufa[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/01f50d8bd3f6d6551c0aeb1049bc007c3727e804.png[/img]
She was the most famous sculptor in her city, creating statues of astonishing beauty. However, by dedicating herself entirely to her art, she forgot everything else and ultimately lost it all. On the strange island of Lord Ambermaze, one cannot age or die physically, but it’s all too easy to grow old in spirit…

In our upcoming posts, we’ll introduce you to more inhabitants of the island, as well as new mechanics we’ve devised. Be sure to add Lord Ambermaze to your Wishlist, follow the game’s page, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url]!

Regards,  
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: New mechanics and a new boss — Lava Octopus!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We would like to update you on the development of Lord Ambermaze, including new bosses and biomes that we recently finished.

We have three new biomes to announce! The "forest" biome is finished, while the "dark wood" and "lava" biomes are almost complete – we are still testing these locations while developing new ones. These exclude the "toxic swamps" and the castle of the Dark Lord Ambermaze, which will be full of traps and dangers.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/mDqr5V3/image.gif[/img]

Speaking of biomes, we want to lift the veil of mystery surrounding the "lava" biome. The endless fields of fire will challenge every player, but if you can overcome the first two biomes, you might just be able to cope with the hottest of them all.

But heed our warning! One wrong step will lead to you burning to a crisp or an explosive end!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xFKTv11/image.gif[/img]

We've added a unique "totems" mechanic to this level. If you encounter these statues in the arena, you will feel their immediate effect as they prevent you from using certain game mechanics. For example, enemies will be protected by permanent shields and any attack against them will be meaningless until you destroy the totem.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/gJnDSmD/image.gif[/img]

Once you reach the end of the level, you'll come face-to-face with the Lave Octopus boss. It's an imposing sight and will seem incredibly strong, with the right way, he'll fall with ease.

Our goal with the "lava" biome was to include more puzzles that lead to treasure caches and secret passages to different rooms, and new enemies with different attacks and behavior logic. Now it is definitely the most real, gloomy labyrinth!
 
And we've also added Japanese as a language option to the demo.

Add the game to your Wishlist if you haven't already, play the demo, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url]. Let us know what you think of the demo and let us know if you have any ideas or wishes for the game. All of these will help us improve Lord Ambermaze.


Regards,
Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Check out Funny Enemy Type in the Lava Fields. Kill it with the bow!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our team has been hard at work on the next demo update for Lord Ambermaze. In the latest version, the floor is literally lava in the new biome! And we're including so many additional enemies to challenge players.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/gwgq09Z/2024-04-15-23-02-52-1.gif[/img]

In addition, Lord Ambermaze has set all sorts of clever traps. You'll have to think about overcoming them and getting to your goal faster while taking less damage. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9ZkGt3t/2024-04-15-23-02-52.gif[/img]

We also decided to add one more main weapon - the bow. It can hit and damage targets at a distance of several squares. However, there are a limited number of arrows so you should use them sparingly and you can't replenish them during battle.

In addition, we're working on a brand new boss, but we can't tell you about it just yet. Think you can guess what it is? Let us know in the comments below.

Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Play the first demo of Lord Ambermaze!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our game will be a part of this year's PAX East event, taking place March 21–24 in Boston! In honor of this event, we are unveiling the first big playable demo for Lord Ambermaze.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WyJ6Bs6/image.gif[/img]

A fateful accident brings Zin and his sister Shantee to a strange island ruled by the mysterious Lord Ambermaze. For what purpose has he captured Shantee? How can she be freed? Can you even trust the creatures who not only live here but are willing to help you? All this and more await you in the demo! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bRfpZRH/image.gif[/img]

The demo will include: 
[list]
[*] Tutorial and the first biome of the game;
[*] Six enemies and one boss;
[*] Upgrades and abilities for your hero;
[*] Many rooms with secrets and hiding places.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/p1tPSDc/image.gif[/img]
Experience an atmospheric adventure in the spirit of the classic Legend of Zelda games! Play, stream, and share your impressions of the game here or on [url=https://discord.gg/M83fnAbgWT]Discord[/url].


Regards,
Lord Ambermaze Team

Our game Lord Ambermaze will have different levels of enemies - ordinary, cool dude, mini-boss, boss. Recently, we have been developing mini-bosses.
